card.title: Make the Win Count
card.instruction: Treat success as meaningless unless its difficulty, sacrifice, and personal cost are fully recognized.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you announce my cake won, mention I iced it at three in the morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ribbon got eight hours' sleep. It doesn't tell the full story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I mention the ingredients too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the ones I drove across town for after midnight.

mechanism: A refuses a bare cake victory unless the late-night labor and inconvenience enter its public description.
confusable: Unlike boasting about quality, A must require recognition of difficulty as part of what success means.
comparison: S210-a filters ingredients by procurement sacrifice; S210-b makes a spouse's missed anniversary part of team recognition.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
